title: Introduce prefetch-impact-radar and SLO prognostics
author: Aisha Patel
release_notes: Adds a new observability module (prefetch-impact-radar) that correlates prefetch/warmup effectiveness with token-level cost/latency and a companion SLO prognostics simulation playbook; dashboards and runbook included.
description:
Context: recent incidents (SUP-4021) highlighted that prefetch/warmup heuristics sometimes increase tail cost without meaningful latency improvement for some prompt shapes.

This PR introduces two coordinated pieces: 1) the prefetch-impact-radar — an observability pipeline + dashboard that correlates prefetch delta signals (prefetch hits/false-warms, KV warm counts) against per-invocation token cost and per-stage latency spectra; and 2) an SLO prognostics simulator that projects SLO hit-rate under alternative prefetch/autotune policies so oncall and SRE can reason about tradeoffs before changing policies.

What changed (high level):
- trace-processor: add PrefetchDeltaAggregator that tags spans with prefetch_outcome and warm_affinity scores and emits new metrics (prefetch.delta.count, prefetch.false_warm_ratio, prefetch.warm_affinity_p90)
- metrics: add Prometheus rules and histograms for token_cost_prefetch_bucket and stage_latency_prefetch_split
- dashboards: new "Prefetch Impact Radar" panel group showing cross-correlation heatmaps, per-tenant drift glyphs, and a prognostics control to run scenario simulations
- alerts/playbook: add a playbook entry and a tuned alert (prefetch-impact-high-cost) that uses the simulator to veto noisy alerts and suggests mitigation steps
- sampling: introduce a lightweight prefetched-trace sampler that biases retention towards traces with prefetch delta > 0 to reduce noise and retain signal for evaluation

Motivation: give platform teams a way to quantify whether prefetch warms are actually reducing application-level latency per token (and where they are harmful), and to simulate SLO outcomes before flipping runtime prefetch/autotune knobs. This reduces alert churn and prevents blind policy rollouts.

User-visible changes:
- new dashboard at Observability > Prefetch Impact Radar
- new alert: observability/prefetch-impact-high-cost (default: warning after sustained 10%+ increase in token cost among prefetched invocations for 30m)
- new sampler config: observability.prefetchSampler.enabled (default: true)

Implementation notes / tradeoffs:
- PrefetchDeltaAggregator stitches span edges and uses a lightweight heuristic to compute warm_affinity; there is a small CPU cost at the trace-processor; metric cardinality is bounded by bucketing token_cost_prefetch_bucket into 8 broad buckets.
- Simulator is intentionally conservative: it replays sampled historical traces and applies candidate policy transforms (e.g., reduce prefetch probability, raise warm threshold) to estimate SLO impact; accuracy depends on sample fidelity.

Checklist:
- [x] PrefetchDeltaAggregator impl + unit tests
- [x] Prometheus histograms & recording rules
- [x] Grafana dashboard JSON + panel descriptions
- [x] Alert + runbook entry
- [x] E2E smoke run with sample replay
- [x] Docs: observability/prefetch-impact.md

Links: Linear ENG-2314, incident SUP-4021, design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2314/prefetch-impact-radar

Notes on testing and rollout:
- Feature guarded by observability.prefetchImpactFeatureFlag for 24h ramp in prod
- Sampling defaults on for orgs with >1k monthly invocations to keep downstream costs manageable
- CI: an initial flaky test (trace-processor unit TestTracePrefetchAffinity) failed on first CI run; updated the test harness and retried. See CI summary below.

review_comments: Liam Chen (review): Could we tighten the histogram buckets for token_cost_prefetch_bucket? Broad buckets hide small regressions. Requested a follow-up to add a diagnostic finer bucket set behind a debug flag.
Aisha Patel (reply): Agreed — added a debug finer_bucket_histogram that is gated by observability.debugFineBuckets. Kept the main recording rule to 8 buckets to protect cardinality.
Diego Marquez (review): Simulator is promising. Request: ensure simulator runs do not read full tenant secrets or PII; mask any prompt content used in replay.
Aisha Patel (reply): Simulator operates on anonymized, sampled traces; added explicit masking and retention checks in the simulator harness (see prefetch-impact.md).
Priya Nair (review): Alert threshold looks noisy for small tenants. Suggested alert rate limiter or tenant weighting.
Aisha Patel (reply): Implemented tenant-weighted alerting by scaling the anomaly score with tenant monthly invocation percentile; added notes to runbook.

notes: Rolled out under feature flag; first canary ran in us-west-2 for 6 hours. Observed 0.8% overall token-cost uplift but 6% tail improvement for a large customer that has aggressive prefetch settings. Playbook suggests avoiding blanket increases and tuning per-model warm thresholds.
